_about: SPY monthly put cycles for options_backtest.py. Entry = close of the first trading day after each monthly expiration; expiration = the next monthly. Five puts per cycle at spot x (1 - z x VIX x sqrt(days/365)), z = 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, rounded to $1 (to the nearest $5 where the $1 strike had no trade that day). px = Robinhood's daily close of the expired contract on the entry date (get_option_instruments state=expired, get_option_historicals interval=day), pulled 2026-11-13. spot, exp_close, spy_total_return, above_200d, ret_5d: SPY daily data (Yahoo), same date.
